_doc: What is said at each place of Umrah and Hajj (owner 2026-11-15: every dua, ayah or surah written in full where it is said). References only: no text is written here except exact substrings ('part') of the Hisn al-Muslim chapter they point to. 'hisn' = chapter id (1-based, book order) of content/adhkar/hisn.json; its title is the heading. 'quran' = [surah, ayah] shown in full from the canonical KFGQPC text. Each place shows its whole Hisn al-Muslim text first (never shortened); parts and ayahs follow as what to say. kind: dua = to be said (shaded), hadith = how the Prophet did it, note = a short line of the hadith. Steps get places by the words of their titles ('rules', every matching rule adds; 'stop' ends the search).

say.part: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ ، أَنْجَزَ وَعْدَهُ ، وَنَصَرَ عَبْدَهُ ، وَهَزَمَ الْأَحْزَابَ وَحْدَهُ
